attributes.external_dependencies: ["SiteMinder XPSExport XML (XPSDeployment / XPSPolicyData shapes, archived 12.51 reference)"]
attributes.purpose: Broadcom SiteMinder product adapter, as a migration SOURCE: importer siteminder/xps reads XPSExport XML (every XPS name as data in xps.py, unverified for 12.8/12.9) into its own arc .3.6 (policy domains, realms, rules, policies, auth schemes, user directories linked to consumers, agents), partnerships/OIDC clients as standard integrations served by its identity service, header responses as edge header contracts, the rest as core source objects; sensitive settings withheld (smWithheld); source checks (realms the target leaves unprotected, user directories with no consumer). Renders nothing.

attributes.description: What a migration's SOURCE holds that its target won't run: source objects (ciamSourceObject: a source product's objects with no standard equivalent, carried as what/where/who/how data with a handling), the core check and report over them, the planner hook running the checks of adapters that apply only to the source (Adapter.source_checks), and the federation check for integrations served by an identity service the target doesn't run. A source-only product adapter (SiteMinder first) fills the data and adds its own source checks.

A web access manager's policy store read into the record as a migration source: SiteMinder's XPSExport XML (siteminder/xps) -> policy domains, realms, rules, policies, auth schemes, user directories (linked to directory consumers) and agents in the product's own arc; federation partnerships as standard SAML/OIDC integrations; header responses as edge header contracts; what has no equivalent as source objects (flow 63). Sensitive properties are dropped (presence, purpose and re-provision recorded); XML read through core.sources.xml_document (DOCTYPE/ENTITY refused). Maps onto the planned neutral protected-web-application layer later.

attributes.name: xml_document
attributes.purpose: Parse an imported XML text: (root element, None), or (None, why not): a DOCTYPE or entity declaration refused before parsing, a malformed document named with the parser's message

attributes.name: source_objects
attributes.purpose: Every source object (ciamSourceObject under ou=source-objects) in DN order

attributes.name: check_source_objects
attributes.purpose: Planner check: for every source object a role of the source holds, in place when the target still runs the role, else an action for its owner by the cutover, or a blocker when ciamBlocking says the move waits for its handling

attributes.name: source_object_rows
attributes.purpose: Report source-objects: one row per source object (name, product class, role, handling, blocking, owner, how, facts)

attributes.name: check_served_integrations
attributes.purpose: Planner check: a blocker for every integration registered (ciamServedBy) with an identity service whose server role the source runs and the target doesn't, naming the target's running services to re-home to; silent otherwise

attributes.name: applies
attributes.purpose: Whether the SiteMinder adapter applies: the environment runs a SiteMinder product (servers' or workloads' ciamProductVersion)

attributes.name: name_of
attributes.purpose: A SiteMinder name as an entry name: lower case, unsafe characters as '-' (automation.pipelines.slug)

attributes.name: named
attributes.purpose: The DN cn=<name>,<base>

attributes.name: export_objects
attributes.purpose: An XPSExport document as plain objects: every Object element depth first (class, XID, properties by their name after the last dot, links resolved through LinkValue and XREF/ReferenceValue, parent XID, child XIDs), and the release the root element says it is from

attributes.name: kind
attributes.purpose: The kind the adapter maps an XPS object's class to (KINDS), or None

attributes.name: field_name
attributes.purpose: The XPS property a field of a kind is read from (FIELDS; any kind's name: Name; else the field itself)

attributes.name: values_of
attributes.purpose: The values of an object's field

attributes.name: value_of
attributes.purpose: The first value of an object's field, or None

attributes.name: links_of
attributes.purpose: The XIDs an object's link field names

attributes.name: link_of
attributes.purpose: The first XID an object's link field names, or None

attributes.name: name
attributes.purpose: What an XPS object is called: its Name, else its XID after the class

attributes.name: is_true
attributes.purpose: Whether an XPS boolean text is true

attributes.name: sensitive
attributes.purpose: Whether a property is withheld: a sensitive name (SENSITIVE), an encrypted-looking value (ENCRYPTED) or a value the store's secret patterns match

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.purpose: What a withheld setting is, in words (PURPOSES, else generic)

attributes.name: cleaned
attributes.purpose: An object's settings the record may hold and the withheld ones as '<property>: <what it is>; re-provision in the target'

attributes.name: config
attributes.purpose: smConfig JSON of an object's settings the import doesn't map to their own attribute, or None

attributes.name: sm_attrs
attributes.purpose: The smObject attributes every imported entry carries: XID, class, config, withheld

attributes.name: facts
attributes.purpose: An object's kept settings as source-object facts '<property> <values>', in property order

attributes.name: unique
attributes.purpose: A name made unique under a base among the names already taken (name, name-2, ...)

attributes.name: entry
attributes.purpose: An imported entry merged with what the record holds: owned attributes replaced, the rest and its other classes kept

attributes.name: with_rest
attributes.purpose: An import group (dn, entries) with the record's other entries below dn kept

attributes.name: agent_role
attributes.purpose: The server role an agent runs on from its type: sm-access-gateway for SPS/Access Gateway, else sm-agent

attributes.name: is_custom_scheme
attributes.purpose: Whether an authentication scheme runs the operator's own library (its type says Custom)

attributes.name: agent_entry
attributes.purpose: The smAgent entry of an agent (its type, server role unless the record set one)

attributes.name: scheme_entry
attributes.purpose: The smAuthScheme entry of an authentication scheme (type, protection level, library)

attributes.name: directory_servers
attributes.purpose: The host[:port] values a user directory's Server setting names

attributes.name: directory_entry
attributes.purpose: (smUserDirectory entry, notices): namespace, the role and port of its servers (hosts_role), the consumer it binds as (consumer_by_bind_dn), notices for an unrecorded consumer, hosts of no single role, no TLS

attributes.name: subject
attributes.purpose: A policy's user selection as '<user directory> <kind> <value>'

attributes.name: realms_of
attributes.purpose: Every realm of a policy domain, nested ones too, in document order

attributes.name: domain_group
attributes.purpose: (domain DN, entries): a policy domain with its realms (agent, scheme, timeouts), their rules and its policies (rules, responses, user selections), the import owning the domain's subtree

attributes.name: binding
attributes.purpose: The standard SAML binding a SiteMinder binding value names (URN, HTTP-POST, POST, ...), or None

attributes.name: nameid
attributes.purpose: The standard NameID format a URN names (its last part), or None

attributes.name: match_key
attributes.purpose: What an integration is matched by: (protocol, partner entity ID) for SAML, ('oidc-client', client ID) for OIDC

attributes.name: held_integrations
attributes.purpose: {match key: integration the record holds}

attributes.name: local_entities
attributes.purpose: The local entity IDs of the SAML partnerships, each once

attributes.name: service_for
attributes.purpose: (the identity service new integrations are served by, its entry when the import makes cn=siteminder, notices): the record's service with the local entity ID, else cn=siteminder from the local entity and base URL (role sm-policy-server)

attributes.name: place
attributes.purpose: ({XID: (integration DN,)}, {XID: held integration}): a held integration keeps its DN, a new one is named after the partnership, unique

attributes.name: integration_groups
attributes.purpose: (groups, notices): an integration for every partnership and OIDC client (entity ID, ACS/SSO URL, binding, NameID, certificate by fingerprint, claims linked to user-schema records, served by SiteMinder's service); those the record holds kept as they are with smObject added

attributes.name: parts
attributes.purpose: (response type, name, expression) of a response attribute '<name>=<expression>'

attributes.name: is_header
attributes.purpose: Whether a response attribute is an HTTP header the agent sets under a name a header contract can hold

attributes.name: header_value
attributes.purpose: (ciamHeaderKind, ciamHeaderValue, withheld) of a header expression: a user attribute or the user DN is identity; a fixed value is withheld like a shared secret

attributes.name: header_entry
attributes.purpose: The header contract a header response attribute becomes: set by sm-agent unless the record says otherwise, trust and stripping left to the record

attributes.name: carried_name
attributes.purpose: What a source object is called before it is made unique: '<kind>-<SiteMinder name>' (the keys: 'keys')

attributes.name: carried_entry
attributes.purpose: The ciamSourceObject of kind k (CARRY: handling, role, blocking, how) for object o (None: the key store), its facts, concerns and import time; a recorded one keeps the record's handling

attributes.name: placements
attributes.purpose: ({XID: DNs} of every object that becomes entries, XID#<kind> for the source object an auth scheme or gateway agent also is; {XID: held integration})

attributes.name: release
attributes.purpose: A SiteMinder version as PEP 440: a two-digit minor (12.52) split as a service pack of its release (12.5.2)

attributes.name: read_export
attributes.purpose: Importer siteminder/xps: Imported from XPSExport XML files (DOCTYPE refused, other releases refused): policy domains, realms, rules, policies, schemes, user directories, agents in ou=siteminder; partnerships as integrations; header responses as header contracts; the rest as source objects; sensitive settings withheld with notices

attributes.name: realm_role
attributes.purpose: The server role a realm's agent runs on (sm-agent when it names none)

attributes.name: check_realms
attributes.purpose: Source check: a blocker for every realm protected by agents the source runs and the target doesn't (its rules, granting policies, sign-on scheme and headers stop)

attributes.name: check_user_directories
attributes.purpose: Source check: an action for every user directory binding as an account no directory consumer records
